title: Old genlock-host processes exit when their session ends, instead of piling up

fields.why: Earlier session found ~10 leaked genlock-host processes back to Nov 6; they hold stale network state (old adb gets No route to host)

text: On TJ's Mac, pgrep -fl 'genlock-host run' shows genlock-host processes from sessions long ended (back to Nov 6). genlock-host is the per-session PTY host binary shipped in /Applications/Genlock.app/Contents/MacOS, source under app/Sources. Find why it outlives its session (parent exit, socket close, app relaunch) and make it exit; add a test in app/Tests if possible. Do not kill live sessions' hosts.
